reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: European Union Global Access and Trade Expertise (EU GATE) Cambodia

description.narrative:
The Outcome of European Union Global Access and Trade Expertise (EU GATE) is to improve regulations, measures and practices in Cambodia in support of inclusive and sustainable exports to the EU and regional markets. This Outcome objective includes a strong focus on environmentally sustainable and socially inclusive trade with the EU and the region. The Outcome focuses on four main targets:

·The Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC) negotiates agreements, understandings, or undertakings with key trading partners in the process of Least Developed Country (LDC) graduation, that promote the EU approach to environmentally sustainable and socially inclusive trade.

·RGC develops and adopts key reforms that strengthen the business environment and protect consumers, support a deepening of the digitalization of its economy, and embrace inclusive and sustainable trade in a manner that promotes the external dimension of EU internal policies or EU interests.

·The average time of import/export processing from arrival to physical release (combined for all border crossing points and for all modes: sea, air, and road) decreases, thereby improving the cost competitiveness of all exporters and importers operating in Cambodia.

-SMEs supported by the project, including women-led SMEs, develop export readiness and increase their exports to EU and/or ASEAN markets by 30% from their baseline
